subject: Owner's FSM + pure-strategy + saturation architecture, reviewed, repaired, implemented and measured.
verdict: ADOPTED_WITH_FOUR_REPAIRS. The design is sound. Implemented literally it would have reintroduced defects the project already fixed, and its central worry turned out to be the wrong worry.

defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.defect: sorted(candidates)[:n] on all three lists. The prose alongside it says to avoid alphabetical order and use registry or dimension priority; the code does exactly what the prose forbids.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.why_it_matters: This is the defect class D1-D4 already repaired in this project. Three separate defects here have been lexicographic accident acting as a decision rule.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.repair: Ordering is by extent size, most specific first. Concept id breaks ties only, and is documented as a tiebreak.

defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.defect: secondary is filled with L2 middle categories BEFORE L1 direct-evidence overflow.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.why_it_matters: Reverses the D1 repair. A participant who names four words has the fourth displaced by a category the system chose. explicit_expression_retention drops below 1.0, which is the single property justifying strict-evidence mode.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.repair: Stated-but-unshown evidence occupies secondary ahead of any system-chosen representative.

defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.where: main fallback admitting one L3 direction as a placeholder
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.defect: Contradicts the proposal's own stated constraint that main and secondary carry only NAMED_DESCRIPTOR, and duplicates overall_profile, which draws its directions from the same activated dimensions.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.why_it_matters: The same word would appear twice in one result. output_policy_r9 validates duplicates within main+secondary only, so this would pass validation and still be visibly wrong.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.repair: Role separation kept absolute. The motive behind the proposal (avoid an empty main) is real and is addressed instead by declaring an honest dimension-level category, measured below.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_OWNER — if the owner prefers the placeholder, it needs a de-duplication rule against overall_profile.

defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.defect: Undeclared magic numbers doing real ranking work.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.repair: Removed entirely. Entailment is set containment and ranking is extent size, so there is nothing left to tune.

defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.defect: Each concept's rung is hardcoded, so the ladder cannot express that a category may be narrower than its dimension.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.repair: The ladder is derived: extent size orders the concepts, and the rungs fall out. This is what makes ROUND2-OP4 structurally impossible rather than merely fixed.

defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.where: the worked example 'user picks fruit direction -> output citrus'
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.defect: Not achievable honestly. broad.citrus covers 2 of 23 fruity words. Answering the fruit direction does not entail citrus.
defects_found_in_the_proposal_as_written.note: The owner's instinct that an intermediate layer exists was correct; it lives in the question axis partitions, not the concept registry.

defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.defect: output_generator_round2, declared CURRENT PRODUCT PATH in contract section 6b, read state['k1']['dimensions'] as a list of {dimension_id,status} rows. The frozen R9 schema, enforced by output_policy_r9 and exercised in test_output_policy_r9, is a Mapping {dimension_id:{'supported':float}}. Every real state raised AttributeError.
defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.how_it_survived: It had only ever been run on states the operator invented to match his own misreading.
defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.repair: evidence_reader_round2 normalises both shapes; the frozen Mapping is canonical.

defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.defect: Direct evidence required a selected option id to be a NAMED_DESCRIPTOR in the registry. Zero of the 28 product options are registry concepts; all are partition names. Direct evidence was structurally unreachable, so every session fell through to dimension-level output. k1.confirmed_concepts was also ignored.
defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.significance: This, not the inference rule, was the mechanism behind the over-normalisation the owner asked about.
defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.repair: Options resolve through the axis partitions. A singleton partition (13 of 23) pins one concept and is direct evidence; a multi-member partition is set evidence and is never promoted to any single member.

defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.defect: broad.citrus was the only representative for the fruity dimension, so a participant whose evidence supported no more than 'fruity' was told 'citrus'.
defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.cause: The six dimension-level broad concepts added in round 2 were layered into a namespace already holding three sub-dimension ones from the sealed R9 contract (broad.chocolate, broad.citrus, broad.nutty). The generator treated all nine as interchangeable representatives for a dimension. The collision was introduced by the operator.
defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.user_visible_consequence: Someone who tasted mango is told 'citrus'. That is false, not vague.
defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.repair: Extents are declared per concept; entailment requires the evidence set to be contained in the concept's extent, so a narrower category can never be reached from wider evidence.

defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.defect: A single-candidate-set model would intersect all answers, so answering 'fruit' then 'nuts' yields the empty set and the participant is told nothing despite having said two things.
defects_found_in_the_operator_s_own_ship.repair: State carries one branch per thing said. A later answer refines the branch it intersects and opens a branch when it intersects none.

the_owner_s_question_answered.asked: How do we avoid the small dataset forcing everything toward the same output?
the_owner_s_question_answered.finding: Over-normalisation is not the failure mode. Across all 170 reachable sessions the machine produces 161 distinct outputs and the most common single output accounts for 1.76 percent.
the_owner_s_question_answered.the_actual_constraint: The reachable space is small, not repetitive. 170 sessions is the entire product answer space, and only 15 of the registry's 88 concepts can ever appear in a result. 36 of 56 specific words are touched by no question, so no evidence for them can ever exist.
the_owner_s_question_answered.where_the_leverage_is: Question coverage, not the inference algorithm. The largest indistinguishable cell is 19 fruits (apple, banana, cherry, mango, peach and 14 more) that no question separates.

measured_effect_of_the_one_change_tested.change: declare a dimension-level broad.fruity, the only large dimension with no honest middle category
measured_effect_of_the_one_change_tested.note: Measured over the same 170 enumerated sessions. Not applied: creating a concept is an owner decision.

owner_decisions_required.question: broad.chocolate has no clean extent source and is unusable until declared.

options.C: retire it; broad.nutty and the specific words already cover nutty_cocoa

owner_decisions_required.current_effect: nutty_cocoa evidence at dimension level falls through to the direction rather than being over-claimed.

owner_decisions_required.question: Create broad.fruity as a dimension-level category?
owner_decisions_required.recommendation: yes; it is the largest dimension and the only one where honest middle-level output is currently impossible

owner_decisions_required.question: Question coverage. 36 of 56 words are unreachable and the largest unseparated cell is 19 fruits. Extending the fruit axis is the single highest-leverage change available.
owner_decisions_required.recommendation: treat as the next work item, ahead of any further inference work

owner_decisions_required.question: All 8 question axes carry product_use_eligible=false with reason INFORMATION_GAIN_AND_USER_COMPREHENSION_NOT_VALIDATED. Nothing is shippable until that is resolved, and the diversity measurement above had to ignore the flag to produce any sessions at all.
P3: allow a direction to occupy a main slot when main would otherwise be empty?

verification.regression_pins: each of OP2, OP3, OP4, OP5 has a test that fails if it returns
verification.mutation_check: test_mutating_an_extent_is_caught deliberately widens broad.citrus and requires entailment to fire, so the non-entailment assertion is not vacuous
